about: A markdown_block read stands alone on its line (chapter 5 § 5.2.6; #1543, ruling 2). The note, a markdown_block, ends with Sincerely, and the profile's closing after a blank line. Invalid: the closing on the line of Sincerely,. Valid: on its own line, after a blank line.
sentences: Deliverable 'note' has text before {{ profile.closing }}, a markdown_block, at line 3; a markdown_block read stands alone on its line.
